english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for sounds or speech made up of separated, non-continuous parts.
This is the all-purpose choice when the patchiness means interruptions or gaps over time.

examples.english: His speech was staccato and hard to follow.
examples.traditional: 佢講嘢斷斷續續，成段說話聽落好唔順。

examples.english: The rain has been patchy lately, so the clothes never dry properly.
